text:
amal: Quick sync  we need a compact launch artifact tying routing tiers to launch gates and a demo toggle for sales.

noah: Proposed tiers: shard (cost-opt), geo-isolate (residency + soft-affinity), island (dedicated compute). For each list SLOs, cache semantics, allowed egress, and contract requirements.

rebecca: Customers want predictable p99 and a clear residency promise. They'll accept throughput limits for stronger isolation. Sales needs a short UI toggle copy + percent uplift ranges.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: policy-canary deployed to canary-3 (logs: https://ci.redwood/rollouts/3).

amal: Draft launch checklist: 1) tiny policy DSL + unit tests, 2) telemetry widgets & alert thresholds, 3) migration playbook (canary 5 tenants), 4) cost multiplier table, 5) legal/residency sign-off.

noah: Operational note: allow cross-region KV peeking only opt-in; document p99 delta and egress multiplier.

rebecca: UI demo text suggestion: "Strong Isolation  Dedicated compute & data residency. Price uplift: +30120% (sample)". Include an explainer paragraph for sales.

amal: Action items: amal -> one-pager; noah -> migration playbook + chaos checklist; rebecca -> demo copy + pricing ranges. Reconvene Tue 10am.

noah: Keep DSL tiny for v1. Example: policy: tier:"geo-isolate"; affinity:"soft"; kv:"region-local"; fallback:"region-compat"; sla_p99_ms:120

amal: Perfect. Posting draft Monday.
